_notes: layer: surface | orbital | deep_space | asteroid. Surface slots scale with planet size/class; each body has orbital ring slots; deep-space structures are placed freely near lanes/Lagrange points. cost/upkeep are placeholder numbers using resources.json ids. source: canon | beta | original. Surface economy fields (game prototype, all optional): storage = capacity it adds for stockpiled materials; recipes + cycles_per_min = converts stock (each recipe takes in, gives out; cycles shared between the recipes that have input); requires_depleted + reopen_share = built on a used-up deposit, reopens it once at that share of its first size; requires_level = its base core must be at least this level (stands in for requires_tech until research exists); research_per_min = research points toward the chosen tech; wear_per_min = condition lost per minute while it works (see surfaces.json maintenance); levels = upgrades after the base (Mk I): each has its own cost, build_seconds, optional requires_level and modifiers (the totals at that level: stat speed | yield | wear as a share, or auto_maintain); produces + production_queue = surface units it assembles (their cost and build_seconds are in surfaces.json units), one at a time, up to that many orders waiting. footprint_radius = how far the building reaches from its tile centre, in world units (a hex is 25 across, 12.5 from its centre to an edge): vehicles driving into, through or out of the tile keep footprint_radius + surfaces.json lanes.clearance from the centre (a ring around it); without it lanes.default_footprint applies, and footprint_radius + clearance may be at most 12. access = [x, z] in the building's own frame (+z = its front, turned with its facing): where a vehicle ordered onto the tile parks (the cores' repair pad, the Vehicle Bay's apron, the refinery's pod-pad side, the storage yard's front); between footprint_radius and 12.4 from the centre; without it a vehicle parks on the ring facing the way it came.
